types.description: Provisional generic HMI with Ethernet; DC supply; voltage not specified.

connectionCoverage.notes: Reviewed generic interface: Supply L+/M is universally required. DC supply; voltage not specified. Optional: ETH communication by application, including an offline powered HMI. Unmodeled: extra power feeds, ports, shields, bonding, display and operator functions. Supply magnitude, other ratings, Ethernet connector and protocol are unspecified; the author must select hardware and add its connection inventory and ratings. L+/M and ETH are the same logical generic markings as the PLC, not a manufacturer pinout. The io-module profile represents the electrical interface only; it does not draw a display.
